WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    SUM(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(12,2))) / SUM(CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
cross_media_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) as overall_avg_bpm
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  AVG(mts.avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(mts.bytes_per_millisecond) as avg_of_bytes_per_millisecond,
  AVG(mts.bytes_per_millisecond) - cma.overall_avg_bpm as avg_rate_above_average
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN cross_media_average cma
WHERE mts.bytes_per_millisecond > cma.overall_avg_bpm
